statement: When a MotionPlus is active with its downstream extension-connected flag true but Dolphin lacks a downstream extension ID, ControllerInterface reads four bytes starting A400F6; it decodes bytes at read offsets 2,0,3 as the normal extension ID bytes 0,4,5 respectively. Dolphin's emulated MotionPlus stores those values in positions F8,F6,F9 after reading a downstream extension's six-byte FA identifier; the intervening F7 byte is a challenge-state byte, not one of those ID fields. A400FA remains the active MotionPlus's own six-byte mode/identity; the two addresses answer distinct questions. The reviewed WiiBrew MotionPlus page describes A400FA identity and pass-through modes but does not document this F6 mirror. This is solid Dolphin consumer and emulator evidence, not verified retail hardware layout.
